items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: he had been with Kirby, John Kirby and all that

ctx.x: What a shame. Oh, Neil Spencer didn't have such a big name anyway.

No, but he had been with Kirby, John Kirby and all that, you know. His name was much -- no-one knew who I was. They said, "That little kid who drops the bombs." That was about the biggest name I ever got. "That little kid who drops the bombs up at Minton's. You remember what's his name?"
